verdict.rationale: FreeAgent's own pricing page documents smart categorisation that automatically explains new transactions based on previous descriptions. This covers automatic categorisation of incoming transactions and implies learning from the user's past explanations. However, there is no explicit documentation that it learns from corrections or presents suggestions for review rather than auto-applying them, and the evidence is a single marketing line. missing for 10: explicit learning-from-corrections behaviour, suggestion/review workflow for imported bank transactions, in-depth feature docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get automatic categorization suggestions for imported transactions that learn from my corrections

citations.quote: Save time with smart categorisation which automatically explains new transactions based on previous descriptions.
